name: convo_v4_chat_history
description: Resume helper (S4): read a chat turn by id and return its history if it belongs to this session.

inputParameters.queryExpression: .sessionId as $sid | (.prev | if type == "object" then (.response.body? // .workflow? // .) else null end) as $w | (($w | type) == "object" and $w.status == "COMPLETED" and $w.correlationId == $sid and $w.workflowName == "convo_v4_chat_turn" and (($w.output.history | type) == "array")) as $ok | {found: $ok, history: (if $ok then $w.output.history else [] end)}
